subject: Co-innovation pilot: Runway Labs SDK tracing + LangChain/LlamaIndex compatibility
messages:
From: Devon Miles <devon@runwaylabs.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring a Runway + Redwood tracing & LangChain/LlamaIndex pilot

Hey Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at BayAI last month — Runway Labs really liked Redwood's focus on production inference economics. We have a product push this quarter to make our SDKs first-class citizens in LangChain/LlamaIndex ecosystems and want to ensure telemetry/tracing and co-sell readiness from day 1.

High level ask: run a 6-week co-innovation pilot where Runway adapts its "runway-sdk" to expose lightweight trace hooks (OpenTelemetry traces + token-level metadata) and Redwood validates the integration across:
- LangChain agent flows (chained prompts + tools)
- LlamaIndex retrieval + response streaming
- End-to-end KV cache / prefix caching impact on trace fidelity

Outcomes we care about: 1) validated trace schema and small sample trace map; 2) perf delta matrix (latency/cost) for common flows; 3) a joint marketing blurb + one co-authored blog post if pilot looks good.

Proposed commercial model: 6-week pilot, Redwood provides SDK guidance + infra credits (~$5k equivalent), Runway covers engineering time; optional expansion to a co-sell offering after pilot. I've attached a short SOW draft (Runway-Integration-SOW-v1.pdf) that outlines milestones.

Can we get a 30-min sync this week with your integration/observability lead and Marissa from SDK partnerships?

Thanks,
Devon Miles
Head of Partnerships, Runway Labs
devon@runwaylabs.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Runway-Integration-SOW-v1.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Devon Miles <devon@runwaylabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring a Runway + Redwood tracing & LangChain/LlamaIndex pilot

Devon — great to hear from you and glad the conference intro paid off. I moved your SOW to the team and copied Marissa (ISV partnerships) and Karthik (runtime/tracing) who will drive the technical scope. Kimberly is on our marketplace/commercial side and will weigh in on co-sell economics.

We can definitely do a focused 6-week pilot; a couple of asks from our side before the sync so we come prepared:
- Security/compliance: run a short security questionnaire (we can send our standard ISV checklist).
- Technical pre-reqs: repo access to runway-sdk examples + sample LangChain/LlamaIndex flows you care about (preferably <3 canonical flows).
- Success metrics: can you confirm the 3 KPIs (trace fidelity, end-to-end median latency delta, integration stability over 1k simulated sessions)?

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min sync: Thu May 3, 11:00-11:30 PT (please confirm)
2) We'll share a Redwood pilot template (attached) and a short mutual action plan in advance.
3) Post-sync: alignment on owner roles, test harness, and an initial runbook for telemetry ingestion.

I attached our pilot template (Redwood-pilot-template.docx) to speed contract and onboarding. If the date works, Kimberly will scope the commercial credit and Marissa will map customer-facing deliverables.

—Vanessa
VP, Partnerships & Alliances
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood-pilot-template.docx (docx, 28KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Devon Miles <devon@runwaylabs.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring a Runway + Redwood tracing & LangChain/LlamaIndex pilot — MAP & tech owners

Thanks Vanessa + Devon — looping in a short mutual action plan so we can move from discussion to kickoff quickly. I kept it intentionally tight.

Mutual Action Plan (6-week pilot)
1) Week 0 (Prep) — Share SDK sample repos, security questionnaire, and Redwood pilot template (done).
2) Week 1 — Technical sync (LangChain, LlamaIndex owners + runtime). Confirm trace schema (attributes: request_id, user_agent, prompt_tokens, model_variant, route).
3) Week 2-3 — Instrumentation: Runway opens a feature branch that emits OpenTelemetry spans at prompt/token boundaries; Redwood provides test harness and synthetic load (1k sessions).
4) Week 4 — Telemetry validation + latency/cost benchmarking; deliver draft trace map and perf matrix.
5) Week 5 — Stability & edge-case testing (tool-calls, streaming, chunked retrieval).
6) Week 6 — Wrap: joint post, handoff doc, and commercial discussion for co-sell listing.

Tech owners and contacts
- Runway: Devon Miles (partnership) and Asha Patel (eng).
- Redwood runtime & tracing: Karthik Iyer (karthik@redwood.com) — primary; Marissa (partnership) — product/marketing liaison.
- Marketplace/commercial: Kimberly Park (kimberly@redwood.com).

Integration specifics (notes from Karthik / quick wins):
- Preferred trace format: OTLP gRPC export to a temporary demo collector, with JSON-friendly attributes to ease query joins in our console.
- Token-level fields: include token_index and token_boundary flags for streaming flows (helps attribution vs batching).
- Fallback policy: when KV cache hits occur, ensure the span indicates cached=true and include cache_key.

Open questions for the sync:
- Are there existing LangChain tool examples you want instrumented (e.g., web_search, sql_db)?
- Any NDA/marketing constraints for the joint blog?

Next actions: Devon, please confirm the Thu May 3 11:00 PT slot and attach the sample repo links. I'll create a short HubSpot deal note and a shared Drive folder (linked below) and will upload a simple test harness repo.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRunwayPilot

—Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, ISV Partnerships
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: (mutual action plan inline)

From: Devon Miles <devon@runwaylabs.ai>

Subject: Re: Exploring a Runway + Redwood tracing & LangChain/LlamaIndex pilot — MAP & tech owners

Thanks — slot confirmed for Thu May 3 11:00 PT (Devon, Asha, Karthik, Marissa). We've attached a signed SOW stub to speed procurement (Runway-signed-SOW.pdf).

Quick answers to open questions:
- LangChain examples: we'll share 2 canonical flows in the repo: multi-step QA agent (web_search + summarize) and a tool-driven db query agent (sql_runner).
- Marketing: no embargo on a joint blog; Runway legal asked for a simple 7-day review window post-draft.

Repo links (private):
- https://github.com/runwaylabs/runway-sdk/tree/pilot/langchain-examples
- https://github.com/runwaylabs/runway-sdk/tree/pilot/llamaindex-examples

We look forward to the sync. If you want, I can drop the OTLP collector command we'll use into the shared Drive before the call.

Best,
Devon
Head of Partnerships, Runway Labs
